title: New Car Depreciation: Why a New Car Makes You Poorer
alts: Your New Car Loses $27 a Day. Here's Where It Goes.
New vs Used Car: The Real Cost Nobody Tells You
line1: Why does a new car make you poorer? It can lose ~$10,000 in year one and costs ~$12,863 a year to own (AAA). Here's where the money goes.
summary: Dave drives his first brand-new car off the lot, and before the first red light it's worth thousands less. We break down new car depreciation (Kelley Blue Book, iSeeCars), the true cost of owning a car from AAA's 2026 Your Driving Costs study, why 72 and 84-month car loans leave people underwater (Edmunds), where dealers really make their money (finance office, add-ons and service), the opportunity cost of a bigger car payment, and why a 2-3 year old used car is often the sweet spot.
